Hi Maria — great to hear from you, and welcome aboard. Short answers up front then a couple of options so you can pick what fits your org:

- Portal-first: we can onboard you to our AP Portal (invoices@aurorahealth.com as the receiving endpoint). You can either accept invoices via SSO/OAuth (recommended) or we can push nightly bundles over SFTP. The portal adds invoice acknowledgement and line-level metadata so your ERP can reconcile more easily.
- Email PDF: we can deliver PDF invoices to ap@aurorahealth.com (single- or multi-entity attachments). This is what we do for customers that cannot onboard to the portal immediately.

For VAT/reverse-charge: we will include an explicit VAT section and a line that reads "Reverse charge - customer liable for VAT" when you supply your VAT ID and confirmation that reverse charge applies.

PO in filename: yes — we can include PO{PO_NUMBER}_Redwood_Invoice{YYYYMMDD}.pdf as a naming convention.

Attachments I'm sending: AP-portal-onboarding-guide.pdf (high level), sample_invoice_redwood.pdf (example layout). If you prefer portal onboarding I can kick off the invite flow; it needs an initial contact and a portal admin to accept SSO. If you prefer email copies, confirm the single address or a list of recipients and whether you want monthly consolidated invoices or per-transaction.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
